title: Pentaho BI Developer - ME Associate
description: Hands-on workshop for the BI Developer. Build business-friendly semantic models with Pentaho Metadata Editor — physical layer, business models, relationships, business views, properties, reusable concepts, and security — then publish XMI domains for ad-hoc Interactive Reporting.

assistant.subject: Pentaho Metadata Editor (physical layer, business models, concepts and publishing XMI domains)
suggestions: What's the difference between the physical layer and a business model?
How do I build a business model from my database tables?
How do concepts and inheritance work in Metadata Editor?
How do I publish my domain so Interactive Reports can use it?

moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: Meet Pentaho Metadata Editor (PME) and the metadata domain — the physical layer and business model layer that turn raw database tables into a business-friendly semantic layer for ad-hoc reporting.

moduleSummaries.title: Domains & Models
moduleSummaries.summary: The anatomy of a metadata domain, then three guided builds against the SteelWheels SampleData: explore the prebuilt SteelWheels domain, build the OrdersME star-schema domain from scratch, and assemble queries with the Query Builder.

moduleSummaries.title: Properties
moduleSummaries.summary: Enrich the business model: business tables, columns, and relationships, plus the metadata properties (friendly names, formats, aggregation) that inherit from physical → business → view. Built on the OrderStarCustomer domain.

moduleSummaries.title: Concepts
moduleSummaries.summary: Define reusable metadata Concepts (Number, Currency, ID, Hidden, Date) once in the Concept Editor and apply them across columns so formatting and behaviour stay consistent — then validate in an Interactive Report.

moduleSummaries.title: Security & Data Access
moduleSummaries.summary: Lock the model down with metadata security and row-level data constraints, so different roles see different rows and columns from the same published domain.

moduleSummaries.title: Use Cases
moduleSummaries.summary: Put it together end-to-end: model a MongoDB data source and build Interactive Reports on the resulting metadata domain.
